name: cassette-car
description: Capacitor wrapper that runs the Cassette PWA as an Android app with real media-session controls (steering wheel / Bluetooth / Android Auto). The media session plugin is vendored into android/app/src/main/java/com/rewind/cassette/media so its service can extend MediaBrowserServiceCompat, which Android Auto requires.

scripts.apk:debug: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
